decided.cycle: The monthly maximum falls about every 29-30 days throughout (25, 55, 84, 114, ... 675, 704). That steady spacing points to a cycle of about 29.5 days.
decided.week: The file gives only monthly median, maximum and day of maximum, so there is no daily detail.
decided.level: Monthly medians in year 2 run about 346-575, mean about 464. In year 1 they run about 404-736, mean about 588. That is roughly 20% lower.
decided.year: Months 6-7 have the lowest medians in both years, and medians rise again around months 9-10 in both years. The match is weak, and the spring high in year 1 is not as strong in year 2.
decided.highest_day: Day 291 has the largest monthly maximum, 3959.
decided.second_day: Day 262 has the next-largest maximum, 3803, and it is 29 days from day 291.
decided.peak_shape: The file has no values for the days next to each maximum.
decided.drops: The file lists no minimums or daily values.
decided.stands_out: Every monthly maximum fits the regular ~29.5-day spacing, so none stands out as singular. Days that are not a monthly maximum cannot be seen.

answer.guess: A count tied to the lunar cycle, for example something that peaks around the full or new moon.
